target.name: compare_baseline
target.content: def compare_baseline(observed, baseline):     """Classify failures per package; known failures are kept and reported, never dropped."""     result = {}     for package, failures in observed.items():         known = set(baseline.get(package, []))         current = set(failures)         result[package] = {             "new_failures": sorted(current - known),             "baseline_debt": sorted(current & known),             "baseline_resolved": sorted(known - current),             "status": "FAIL" if current - known else "PASS",         }     return result
